subject: Clarification: SOC 2 carve-out & audit window for Fintricity procurement
messages:
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fintricity.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@fintricity.com>, security@fintricity.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 carve-out and audit window questions for Redwood Inference

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — Fintricity is proceeding with the procurement checklist and we hit a couple of items that need clarification before legal signs off. Two related items:

1) Audit period / SOC 2 coverage: your SOC 2 Type II report appears to cover 2024-06-01 through 2025-05-31. Can you confirm whether there is any gap for the period after 2025-06-01? Our auditors will require either an updated 2025-2026 report or a bridge letter that covers the interim period.

2) Subservice carve-out: We see that you rely on cloud providers and other subprocessors. Specifically, we need confirmation if Redwood is treating AWS (or other cloud providers) as a carve-out or carve-in for the 2025 SOC report. If it's a carve-out, please provide your subservice organization carve-out letter or point us to the cloud provider SOC report you expect us to rely on.

Attachments: I couldn't find an explicit bridge letter in your security portal. Can you either attach the bridge letter (if available) or confirm timeline for when one will be available?

We appreciate a concise response that we can hand to our controls team.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Procurement Manager
Fintricity

---
Fintricity Security Team: Marco and security@fintricity.com included for visibility.
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fintricity.com>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@fintricity.com>, security@fintricity.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 carve-out and audit window questions for Redwood Inference

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details below:

• Audit period: Our latest SOC 2 Type II covers 2024-06-01 to 2025-05-31. We do not yet have the finalized 2025-2026 report. We can provide a bridge letter covering 2025-06-01 through the point when the new report is issued (expected Sept 2026).

• Subservice carve-out: For our hosted and Dedicated offerings, we classify major cloud providers (AWS, GCP) as subservice organizations and treat their SOC reports as carve-out evidence. We will attach the relevant AWS SOC report we used during the 2025 engagement.

I will follow up with our security/compliance lead (Neha) and legal (Evelyn) to attach the formal bridge letter and confirm the exact wording that satisfies your controls team.

Next steps: I will (1) attach the 2025 SOC 2 Type II PDF, (2) attach AWS SOC 2 report excerpt, and (3) share a signed bridge letter by Monday 05/25 if legal confirms wording.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Lead Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 13:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 carve-out and audit window questions for Redwood Inference

Jonas — looping in language for the bridge letter and carve-out confirmation. Draft points below (internal):

1) Audit window: We confirm the SOC 2 Type II report for period 2024-06-01 to 2025-05-31. The auditor has not yet completed testing for 2025-06-01 onward. We should offer a bridge letter that:
   - States there were no material changes to controls since 2025-05-31 through the bridge period (specify dates).
   - Identifies any known exceptions (none) and references monitoring/patching timelines.

2) Subservice carve-out: We treated AWS as a subservice organization on the 2025 engagement (carve-out). We will attach the AWS SOC 2 report we relied on (redacted excerpt is acceptable). We should explicitly state: "Redwood Inference relies on Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a subservice organization and, for the purpose of the SOC 2 examination period noted above, AWS' SOC report was considered as carve-out evidence."

Evelyn — can you please confirm that this wording is fine for Fintricity? If legal prefers different phrasing (e.g., referencing shared responsibility), please suggest edits.

-Neha
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 10:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 carve-out and audit window questions for Redwood Inference

Thanks Neha — the draft looks good. I have two small edits for client-facing language:

1) Replace the definitive phrase "carve-out evidence" with "the auditor's report for AWS was used as complementary evidence and the controls at AWS were not in scope for direct testing by Redwood's auditor" — this avoids implying AWS is the sole owner of controls.

2) For the bridge letter, we should avoid categorical statements about "no material changes" unless we've documented change reviews. Instead we will state: "To the best of Redwood Inference's knowledge, there have been no material changes to our control environment affecting the services covered in the SOC 2 report between 2025-06-01 and [bridge_end_date]. Redwood monitors and remediates control exceptions according to our change control and patch management policies."

I'll prepare a client-facing bridge letter using those edits and send for signature. Can you confirm the bridge_end_date we should use? Jonas — Fintricity asked for coverage through the interim; I propose 2026-09-30 (expected next report in Sept). If procurement needs a shorter window, we can set 2026-06-30.

-Evelyn
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fintricity.com>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@fintricity.com>, security@fintricity.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 17:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 carve-out and audit window questions for Redwood Inference

Hi Priya — attaching the requested materials and the bridge letter draft. Summary below and attachments included:

Summary:
• SOC 2 Type II report (period): 2024-06-01 to 2025-05-31 — see attachment Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf.
• Bridge letter: covers interim 2025-06-01 through 2026-09-30 (we can shorten to 2026-06-30 if you prefer). See attachment bridge_letter_fintricity_20260524.pdf.
• Subservice/org carve-out: Redwood relied on AWS as a subservice organization for portions of the hosted and Dedicated service stack. We treated AWS' SOC report as complementary evidence; the AWS SOC report excerpt we relied upon is attached (aws_soc2_2025.pdf). The bridge letter explicitly references this approach.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report, redacted for public distribution)
- aws_soc2_2025.pdf (excerpt of AWS SOC 2 report used as complementary evidence)
- bridge_letter_fintricity_20260524.pdf (signed by Redwood legal)

If you need any edits to the bridge letter wording or a shorter bridge window for your auditors, please tell us which date range you'd prefer and we will update and re-sign.

Thanks and looking forward to closing procurement.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Lead Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
